Why_this_title: Collection cards come from Expedition, season, Regatta, mine, trains, competitions and teammates; Grand/Thematic rounds extend the loop.
What_to_learn: Build collection systems that increase the value of existing loops.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not add a collection layer unless existing systems can feed it clearly.

Why_this_title: Town Pass adds puzzle lives/moves, city Barn capacity, social purchase gifts and a repeatable post-30 safe.
What_to_learn: A pass can increase utility across several proven loops.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not add temporary capacity perks without end-of-season handling.

Why_this_title: Teams combine lives, products, collection cards, city help, activity scoring and Regatta competition for up to 50 players.
What_to_learn: Social groups should provide practical cross-loop utility.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not scale group size without governance/activity/anti-abuse controls.

What_to_learn: Competitive rails can preserve both side/puzzle and city-management loops.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not let a side mode replace the game's identity in competition.

Why_this_title: Jan Global install spike overlaps a US/platform/source D28 campaign expansion but scopes differ.
What_to_learn: Link source-attributed evidence to total-game trend without merging scopes.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not call source-level campaign the cause of a Global spike without share data.
